demo.title: facts402-pre-trade.sh
demo.code:
# Is this Base token safe to buy at $500? ($0.05)
bankr prompt "Use facts402 guard/check on 0x4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed with position_usd 500"

# Can I still exit $2,500 of it? ($0.02)
bankr x402 call https://guard.facts402.com/v1/guard/exit -X POST -d '{"token":"0x4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed","position_usd":2500}' --max-payment 0.02

# Who is talking about it, and is it a shill farm? ($0.04)
bankr prompt "Get the facts402 pulse for DEGEN over 24h"

# Watch my position for 24h and alert on liquidity pulls or dumps ($0.12)
bankr prompt "Start a facts402 24h watch on 0x4ed4...efed for my $500 position"

# Free headline check, no payment
curl "https://guard.facts402.com/v1/guard/preview?token=0x4ed4e862860bed51a9570b96d89af5e1b0efefed"

setup: No install, API key or account: every route is plain HTTP behind x402 (USDC on Base mainnet)
Pay from your Bankr wallet: the agent or `bankr x402 call` confirms the price first; all prices are $0.02–$0.60, under the default $1 cap
Free previews: GET /v1/guard/preview and /v1/pulse/preview; reading watch events is free with the watch_secret
Base mainnet only; Pulse covers Farcaster (no X/Twitter data). Results are on-chain facts, not investment advice
